verdict.rationale: AWS documents scripted automation through the official CLI, which offers the same functionality as the console from a terminal. It documents OIDC federation so external CI such as GitHub Actions can obtain temporary role credentials without long-lived keys. It also supports non-interactive provisioning and teardown through CloudFormation templates and the CDK, all of which fits headless and CI use. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CI pipeline use, and explicit documentation of non-interactive or headless CLI behavior such as disabling prompts and pagers.
